summary: Executed a comprehensive backend+frontend E2E verification on the public URL for /join-a-board, /admin, legal pages, applicant/assessment persistence, GridFS resume storage, and core auth controls. Most flows passed, with two auth/security regressions found in lockout and CORS preflight behavior.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout did not activate after 5 failed attempts for the same identifier; 6th request still returns 401 instead of expected 429.
Public preflight response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, violating credentialed CORS expectation for admin-cookie auth playbook.

ui_bugs.issue: Console hydration warning observed: invalid DOM nesting (<span> inside <option>) while rendering filter options.

action_items: Fix lockout enforcement so the 6th failed login for same identifier reliably returns 429 with active lock window.
Fix deployed CORS/preflight behavior so credentialed requests expose explicit allowed origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true.
Address admin select/option hydration warning causing invalid DOM nesting warning in console.
After fixes, rerun auth playbook checks plus one regression E2E for /join-a-board + /admin login/session path.
critical_code_review_comments: Lockout key uses request.client.host + email; in proxied/public environments this can fragment identifiers and weaken brute-force protection if host is inconsistent.
App-level CORS middleware is configured for credential support, but observed public ingress response strips that behavior; deployment edge config likely diverges from backend intent.
Applicant persistence and upsert logic correctly preserves created_at and applicant_id, updates updated_at, and stores resume in GridFS (no local disk).
Mongo responses for applicant/admin endpoints correctly exclude ObjectId _id in tested paths.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all executed E2E UI steps passed; one console warning)

seed_data_creation: Created uniquely tagged records for applicants/assessments: qa+join-us-<id>, qa+join-uk-<id>, qa+np-yes-<id>, qa+np-no-<id>, qa+resume-<id>, and UI records qa.ui.us.<id>/qa.ui.uk.<id>@nonprofitboardbuilder.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Core E2E flows passed on public URL: join page desktop/mobile, US+UK applicant submissions, admin login/profile/status/notes/retry, CSV control presence, outside-country API block, assessment marketing-consent branching, testimonials slideshow controls, legal routes. Remaining blockers are auth lockout and CORS preflight credential behavior on deployed endpoint.
rca of the issue: Repro 1 (lockout): send 6 invalid POST /api/auth/login attempts for same test email; responses observed were 401 on all attempts, expected 429 by attempt 6. Likely cause: lockout identifier relies on request.client.host in proxied environment and/or lock state not being evaluated against a stable identifier. Repro 2 (CORS): OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin and Access-Control-Request-* headers returns 204 with Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Likely cause: ingress/edge CORS policy overriding backend middleware response. Mitigation: enforce stable client identifier for lockout and align edge CORS policy with credentialed cookie auth requirements.
